name: ipsocode/hypervel-influxdb
description: InfluxDB connections for Hypervel, with InfluxQL for InfluxDB 1.x, 2.x and 3 through a query builder of its own or Hypervel's, and an SQL database driver for InfluxDB 3

scripts-descriptions.analyse: Run PHPStan over src/ with the level, settings and extensions hypervel/components uses.
scripts-descriptions.conventions: Run the conventions check with this package's settings, .github/conventions.php. Plain PHP: it needs no install.
scripts-descriptions.lint: Report the coding-standard changes php-cs-fixer would make, without writing them.
scripts-descriptions.lint:fix: Apply the coding standard. Risky rules are enabled (see .php-cs-fixer.dist.php) — run `composer test` afterwards, not just before committing.
scripts-descriptions.test: Run the package suite through the Testbench CLI.
scripts-descriptions.test:phpunit: Run the package suite through PHPUnit directly, bypassing the Testbench CLI.
scripts-descriptions.test:parallel: Run the package suite through ParaTest.
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the package suite through ParaTest with PCOV coverage, failing under 100%. Needs the PCOV extension, which the CI image has.
scripts-descriptions.test:purge: Clear cached config, routes, views and runtime SQLite files from the Testbench skeleton.
